changelog:
Major update with expanded telecom management features and simplified documentation.

- Overhauled documentation in SKILL.md to reflect new features.
- Introduced bulk calling with campaign queues and rate-limiting for high-volume dialing.
- Added ChatOps for campaign management via chat commands.
- Integrated Telegram support for remote monitoring and action approvals.
- Enhanced status monitoring with JSON progress reports.
- Removed legacy files and all previous code (17 files deleted), focusing the skill on updated capabilities and easier onboarding.
summary: Turn your AI Agent into a Telecom Operator. Bulk calling, ChatOps, and Field Monitoring.
